import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Arc {
        int source, destination;
        double weight;
        Arc(int s, int d, double w) {
            source = s;
            destination = d;
            weight = w;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        ArrayList<Integer> outgoing = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class Network {
        ArrayList<Node> nodes;
        ArrayList<Arc> arcs;

        Network(int v, int e) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
                nodes.add(new Node());
            }
            arcs = new ArrayList<>();
            arcs.ensureCapacity(e);
        }

        void connect(int from, int to, double cap) {
            arcs.add(new Arc(from, to, cap));
            nodes.get(from).outgoing.add(arcs.size() - 1);
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> augmenting_path(int src, int dst, double[] flow, double[] cap) {
            PriorityQueue<pair> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(new Comparator<pair>() {
                @Override
                public int compare(pair o1, pair o2) {
                    return Double.compare(o2.first, o1.first);
                }
            });

            double[] best_cap = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(best_cap, 0.0);
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);

            best_cap[src] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            pq.add(new pair(best_cap[src], src));

            while (!pq.isEmpty() && best_cap[dst] == 0) {
                pair p = pq.poll();
                double c = p.first;
                int u = p.second;

                for (int idx : nodes.get(u).outgoing) {
                    Arc a = arcs.get(idx);
                    double res = a.weight - flow[idx];
                    if (res > 0) {
                        double nc = Math.min(c, res);
                        if (nc > best_cap[a.destination]) {
                            // Remove old entry if exists
                            Iterator<pair> it = pq.iterator();
                            while (it.hasNext()) {
                                pair pt = it.next();
                                if (pt.second == a.destination) {
                                    it.remove();
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            best_cap[a.destination] = nc;
                            pq.add(new pair(best_cap[a.destination], a.destination));
                            pred[a.destination] = idx;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            cap[0] = best_cap[dst];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = pred[dst]; i != -1; i = pred[arcs.get(i).source]) {
                path.add(i);
            }
            return path;
        }

        double maximize_flow(int s, int t) {
            Network residual = new Network(nodes.size(), 2 * arcs.size());
            double[] f = new double[2 * arcs.size()];
            Arrays.fill(f, 0.0);

            for (int i = 0; i < arcs.size(); ++i) {
                residual.connect(arcs.get(i).source, arcs.get(i).destination, arcs.get(i).weight);
                residual.connect(arcs.get(i).destination, arcs.get(i).source, 0.0);
            }

            double total = 0.0;
            double[] cap = new double[1];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = residual.augmenting_path(s, t, f, cap);
            while (!path.isEmpty() && cap[0] > 0) {
                for (int e : path) {
                    int rev = (e & 1) != 0 ? e - 1 : e + 1;
                    f[e] += cap[0];
                    f[rev] -= cap[0];
                }
                total += cap[0];
                path = residual.augmenting_path(s, t, f, cap);
            }

            for (int idx : residual.nodes.get(s).outgoing) {
                total += f[idx];
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static class pair {
        double first;
        int second;
        pair(double f, int s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }

    static class Tile {
        int x, y;
        long contaminated;
        long traversable;
        int agents, capsules;

        Tile() {
            agents = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            traversable = -1; // all bits set
        }

        int encode(int step) {
            return 2 + x + N * y + N * N * step;
        }

        void isolate() {
            traversable = 0;
        }

        void contagion(int step) {
            if ((traversable & (1L << step)) != 0) {
                traversable &= ~(1L << step);
                contaminated |= (1L << step);
            }
        }

        void propagate(int step) {
            if ((contaminated & (1L << step)) != 0) {
                contagion(step + 1);
                if (x > 0) board[x - 1][y].contagion(step + 1);
                if (x < N - 1) board[x + 1][y].contagion(step + 1);
                if (y > 0) board[x][y - 1].contagion(step + 1);
                if (y < N - 1) board[x][y + 1].contagion(step + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static int N, T;
    static Tile[][] board = new Tile[10][10];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                board[i][j] = new Tile();
                board[i][j].x = i;
                board[i][j].y = j;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    board[i][j].isolate();
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    board[i][j].contagion(0);
                } else {
                    board[i][j].agents = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    board[i][j].capsules = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int step = 0; step <= T; step++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    if (step < T) {
                        board[i][j].propagate(step);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Network net = new Network(N * N * (T + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                Tile t = board[i][j];
                if (t.agents != 0) {
                    net.connect(0, t.encode(0), t.agents);
                }
                if (t.capsules != 0) {
                    net.connect(t.encode(T), 1, t.capsules);
                }
                for (int step = 0; step < T; step++) {
                    if (t.capsules != 0) {
                        net.connect(t.encode(step), t.encode(T), 1000);
                    }
                    if ((t.traversable & (1L << step)) != 0) {
                        if (i > 0 && (board[i - 1][j].traversable & (1L << step)) != 0) {
                            net.connect(t.encode(step), board[i - 1][j].encode(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < N - 1 && (board[i + 1][j].traversable & (1L << step)) != 0) {
                            net.connect(t.encode(step), board[i + 1][j].encode(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0 && (board[i][j - 1].traversable & (1L << step)) != 0) {
                            net.connect(t.encode(step), board[i][j - 1].encode(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < N - 1 && (board[i][j + 1].traversable & (1L << step)) != 0) {
                            net.connect(t.encode(step), board[i][j + 1].encode(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) net.maximize_flow(0, 1));
    }
}
